title: fix(searchbox): use initial input value if provided in the dom
body:
Fix #2289

**Summary**

When we use an input as a container for the searchbox, we do not remove it but just upgrade it to look like a real instantsearch.js widget. However, we do not keep the value of the value if it is set.

**Result**

For consistency, we should keep the value of the input and make it the initial value of the query in instantsearch. This PR does that.

In this screenshot, the input has an initial value and it sets the value of the query.

![screen shot 2017-09-19 at 18 45 26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/393765/30604303-be5507b2-9d6a-11e7-9abb-53e7bd2d8a42.png)
